provenance.prompt: Isometric game building icon for a historical civilization strategy game: a stealth airbase, a low wide angular hangar of matte charcoal-grey faceted panels with a sharp wedge-shaped roof and a wide sloped nose-door, two smaller angular side bays, a short solid control cube with narrow amber slit windows, a solid dark-grey apron with a single plain pale-grey painted runway stripe, and low concrete blast walls around the edge. One building on a small square base plate, three-quarter view from above and slightly right, centred and filling about 80% of a square image. Clean hand-painted 2D game art, bold dark ink outline, flat cel shading with soft highlights, earthy saturated palette, readable at 40 pixels. Plain flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) background, no ground scenery beyond the base plate, no shadows on the background. No flag, no banner, no aircraft, no windsock, no radar mast, no lattice, no insignia, no people, no animals, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no signs, no readable screens, no smoke, no watermark. Square 1:1 image.

provenance.notes: Generated illustration of an invented airbase; no real photograph, artwork, logo or lettering was used. No aircraft is drawn, so no insignia can appear; the Stealth Bomber is a unit, not part of the building. Matte charcoal facets with stone blast walls keep it apart from the Airfield, the Air Force Command and the Strategic Air Command. Source: an owner-saved PNG from Downloads (stealth_airbase.png); the recorded hash is of that saved copy. Checked at full size: no lettering.
